title: "Please feed us"
situation: Early morning: police personnel, brought in by bus and described as hungry, bang on their own bus shouting for food.
where: Janpath market, on the road to Jantar Mantar

lines.text: Please feed us, give us some food!
lines.speaker: police personnel (reported, English)

context: The same report shows three protesters in oversized tees, studded Crocs and bandanas twirling for reels at the crossroads, and loudspeakers repeating the Section 163 order.

buildThis.situation: Morning: a bus of hungry constables; bring Asha's chai and biscuits and they become "soft" for the rest of the day, or sell it at double rate.
